memories.content: Kofi is a former student of Ilse Brandt. He took two of her seminars and earned top marks. He has drafted a polite and specific message asking for a reference letter for a museum fellowship due in three weeks. He intends to send it to Ilse.
Kofi Asante has a message prepared to send to Professor Ilse Brandt via email. Ilse Brandt can receive and read emails. The fellowship deadline is in three weeks from the simulation start time.

memories.content: Ilse is a professor at Ashvale University. She remembers Kofi Asante as a strong student in her seminars, but they have not spoken in eight months. She is busy and receives many requests for references; she prioritizes those from students she remembers well and that are polite and specific.
